sources.entry: AstrBot - A multi-platform AI assistant that connects LLMs to chat apps like Telegram, Slack, and QQ, extensible with Python plugins.

summary.one_liner: AstrBot is an open-source, all-in-one AI agent chatbot platform that connects LLMs and agent services to instant messaging apps such as QQ, Telegram, Slack, and Discord.
summary.what_it_does: AstrBot provides conversational AI infrastructure that runs inside chat apps, covering LLM conversations, multimodal input, agents, MCP, skills, knowledge base, persona settings, and automatic context compression. It connects to a long list of messaging platforms, including QQ, WeChat Work, Feishu, DingTalk, WeChat Official Accounts, Telegram, Slack, Discord, LINE, and Matrix. It supports many model services, including OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and Ollama, plus LLMOps platforms such as Dify, Coze, and Alibaba Cloud Bailian. It also has speech-to-text and text-to-speech service integrations. Functionality can be extended with Python plugins, and the README mentions 1000+ plugins installable with one click. An agent sandbox is described for isolated execution of code and shell calls, and the project includes a WebUI and a web chat UI.
use_cases: build a personal AI companion in QQ or Telegram
run a customer service bot in chat apps
connect an LLM or Dify/Coze agent to Slack, Discord, or Feishu
automate tasks through a chat-based assistant
host a knowledge-base chatbot for a team
extend a chatbot with Python plugins
how_to_run: astrbot init (first run only, to initialize the environment)
Docker / Docker Compose deployment (see official documentation referenced in README)
notable: Connects one agent backend to many IM platforms, including QQ (via OneBot v11), Telegram, Slack, Discord, and WeChat Work
Plugin system with 1000+ plugins stated as one-click installable
Built-in agent sandbox for isolated code and shell execution with session-level resource reuse
Multiple deployment options: uv CLI, Docker, desktop app, launcher, and panel-based installs
caveats: Some platforms are marked Community-maintained, and WhatsApp is listed as coming soon
macOS first run of the astrbot command may take 10-20 seconds due to security checks
Desktop app is described as designed for desktop use and not recommended for servers
